name: POV Lock
description: Declarative preset that locks knowledge, diction, and perception to one viewpoint. Host application is not implemented.
purpose: Prevent accidental head-hopping and knowledge leaks.
writing_goals: Report only what the viewpoint can perceive or infer
Keep diction inside the viewpoint's lexicon
Mark any later POV shift as a hard scene break
Use free indirect style without borrowing other minds
constraints: Do not reveal off-stage facts the viewpoint cannot know
Do not narrate another character's private thought in the same paragraph
Do not treat omniscience as a default rescue
checklist: Viewpoint character is named or uniquely identified
Inferences are labeled as guesses when they are guesses
Scene breaks precede any POV change
